reference.name: Great Channel at Stone Harbor NJ

method.count: One maximum per separate astronomical high-tide cycle, bounded by midpoints of neighboring predicted highs; predictions establish timing only.
source_priority: Accepted Stone Harbor measured high-tide maximum
method.threshold_source: Stone Harbor dashboard THRESH and OFFSET_FROM_MLLW constants; 3.44ft NAVD88 = 6.10ft MLLW.
method.quality: Existing cycle gates: >=90% occupied UTC hourly bins, all six central hourly bins, peak at least one hour from window edges. No fill or extrapolation inside invalid observed cycles.
method.official_crest_rule: Stone Harbor official records have first priority on their reported date, followed by supported nearby gauges in the documented station-priority table. All nearby crest heights are calibrated to flooding Stone Harbor reference levels. Preserve every valid measured Stone Harbor target cycle and timestamp; otherwise a corrected official crest replaces one highest accepted Lewes cycle on that date. Keep the other tide. With no accepted cycle, retain one date-only crest without invented time. Unsupported transfers are excluded.

calibration.reference_source: USGS Great Channel at Stone Harbor NJ
calibration.method: Constant median(Stone Harbor original NAVD88 minus Lewes original NAVD88), fitted on paired accepted high-tide cycles in complete calendar years 2008–2025 where the Stone Harbor reference is at or above 3.44ft NAVD88. No donor threshold.

supportedNearbyCrestTransfers.policy: Use direct accepted Stone Harbor high-tide daily maxima on the reported local crest date when overlapping. Otherwise use a supported same-date Stone Harbor official crest. Fit only flooding reference heights; never impose a donor threshold.

limitations: Backup heights are reconstructed estimates from the flooding-high-tide fit, not direct measurements at the reference gauge.
The current year is YTD through completed tide windows on October 29, not an annualized count.
Unavailable historical cycles remain missing; all annual coverage is supplied.
The nearby-station inventory records the historical Avalon subset explicitly. Townsends Inlet 01411353 is excluded because its historical datum conversion to NAVD88 is not confirmed.
